prompt:
Research the current official GitHub Copilot plans: monthly price and the number of premium requests included in each plan. Cite GitHub's own page or documentation and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing/usage-based-billing-for-individuals | QUOTE: "Copilot Pro+ | $39 USD | 3,900 | 3,100 | 7,000" | CLAIM: The Copilot Pro+ plan includes a total of 7,000 AI credits per month (3,900 base + 3,100 flex allotment).

SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/billing/usage-based-billing-for-individuals | QUOTE: "Copilot Max | $100 USD | 10,000 | 10,000 | 20,000" | CLAIM: The Copilot Max plan includes a total of 20,000 AI credits per month (10,000 base + 10,000 flex allotment).
